description: Simex hospital-demand epidemic scenarios is published by WHO Collaboratory. Simex models epidemic spread and interventions using an age-structured SEIR representation. Its stated coverage is Country-specific scenarios configured with demographic and contact assumptions. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. Source code and setup information are linked through the public repository; nothing was installed or executed. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is MIT. Hospital-demand use depends on the model assumptions; continued package maintenance was not established. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
